messages:
Samir Khan: Hey team — planning to relocate to Lisbon (permanent) in ~7 weeks. Need guidance on payroll cutover, social security, EU tax residency, and how the WFH stipend / coworking reimbursement works in EUR. Also curious if a single headcount in PT creates any tax nexus for Redwood.
Lina Gomez: Congrats, Samir! Top-level: GlobalPayroll supports PT but onboarding takes ~30 days. We'll need your passport, visa/residence card, Portuguese address, local bank IBAN, and signed local payroll addendum.
Ellen Park: Benefits note: if you move to PT and are on local payroll youll be enrolled in Portuguese social security (Segurança Social) and the SNS (national health). 401(k) participation typically ends on local payroll. We can help with 401(k) rollover options.
Samir Khan: If I stay on US payroll temporarily, what changes?
Diego Morales: If you stay on US payroll you'll still have US tax withholding, but you'll likely become tax resident of PT after 183 days or if your center of vital interests shifts. That creates double-tax considerations. We generally recommend local payroll for permanent moves.
Ellen Park: Stipend specifics: WFH stipend is prorated monthly. Coworking reimbursement up to 60 EUR/month with manager pre-approval (submit receipts in expense app). Relocation one-off support is separate and handled via relocation form.
Samir Khan: Any risk of creating Permanent Establishment with a single remote engineer?
Lina Gomez: Single employee alone is low risk, but activity matters. If youre signing contracts, negotiating deals, or leading sales relationships from PT that increases PE risk. We'll run a short legal/tax check.
tax-bot: Tax check request submitted: case tx-1798456789. Expected external counsel ETA: 72 hours. Please provide role description and whether you'll negotiate or sign contracts.
Samir Khan: Im purely engineering (no client negotiations). Also: RSU / equity tax withholding implications?
Diego Morales: Equity taxation triggers depend on local rules. Portugal has specific rules for stock options/RSUs and social charges. We'll run a withholding simulation and share net pay estimate.
people-ops-bot: Created relocate case relocate-1798456789 and linked payroll ticket PR-9021.
Diego Morales: Action items: Samir please fill the internal relocate form and upload passport + address + IBAN to the payroll upload link. Lina will open vendor onboarding. I'll run PE memo and RSU simulation.
Samir Khan: Done  submitted form and uploaded docs to https://payroll.internal/upload/PR-9021.
Lina Gomez: Vendor ticket opened. Estimated vendor onboarding 30-45 days once docs verified. If we miss this month's payroll cutoff youll be paid from US payroll for the first month then cutover.
Ellen Park: One more thing — timezones: Lisbon is UTC+0/UTC+1. Coordinate with your manager about meetings/on-call. We can mark timezone in Slack.
Samir Khan: Thanks all — appreciate the quick help. Will wait for the tax memo. :airplane:
